fact: Five months after Starlink's commercial launch in the Central African Republic (16 March 2026, after the December 2025 agreement with SpaceX), the minister dismantled five unlicensed Starlink-based internet resellers in Bangui on 12 August 2026.
title: Télécoms : le déploiement de Starlink en Centrafrique dope l’activité des fournisseurs d’accès internet illégaux
